description:

 Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,000\+ employees and 24,000\+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.
   

  

 Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.
   

  

**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**
 Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.
   

  

 Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI\-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a senior Product Manager to join our Hospitality Cloud team. You'll own a complex product domain end\-to\-end—spanning enterprise integrations, cross\-functional delivery, and strategic roadmap leadership—while embedding AI\-first thinking at every stage. This role demands someone who thrives in ambiguity, earns stakeholder trust at all levels, and holds a high bar for execution and outcomes.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
 Strategic Product Leadership
   

  

* Own your domain roadmap tied to measurable OKRs—drive outcomes, not just feature delivery.
* Lead structured Problem \& Solution Discovery with internal stakeholders, integration partners, and enterprise customers before committing to build.
* Drive Go\-To\-Market readiness end\-to\-end: from inception through launch, adoption measurement, and post\-release iteration.


 AI\-First Product Thinking
   

  

* Embed AI as a default lens in every discovery phase—ask "how does AI improve this?" before writing requirements.
* Own end\-to\-end development of AI\-powered features including evals and measurable outcome tracking.
* Leverage AI tooling to accelerate your PM workflow; track and share productivity gains with the team.
* Ensure all AI features meet Cvent's responsible AI standards.


 Execution Excellence \& Platform Health
   

  

* Drive delivery accountability: sprint hygiene, backlog depth health, SLI/SLO monitoring, and prod bug leakage.
* Manage third\-party vendor integrations—track deliverables, anticipate bottlenecks, and coordinate resolution of technical challenges.
* Define and execute strategy to hit OKRs, NPS targets, and key product metrics; socialize alignment to business goals.
* Make data\-driven prioritization decisions using Mixpanel, ProductBoard, Sigma, and similar platforms.
* Write crisp, unambiguous requirements and user stories with full acceptance criteria (functional, non\-functional, security, data compliance) before sprint start.


 Stakeholder Influence \& Cross\-Functional Leadership
   

  

* Act as the single point of accountability for product decisions in your domain—own escalation paths and surface deviations with a remedy.
* Lead alignment across Sales, CS, Engineering, UX, and Leadership; build trust at all levels of the org.
* Partner with integration vendors and enterprise customers to gather requirements and translate them into actionable product specs.
* Present roadmap progress and risks clearly to leadership


**Here's What You Need**
* 9–12 years of experience with 5\+ years in product management for SaaS products.
* Hands\-on experience building AI products is a strong plus; proficiency with AI tools is required.
* Proficiency with analytics platforms (Mixpanel, Gainsight PX, Pendo, or similar) to measure and drive adoption.
* Experience with third\-party integrations and enterprise software ecosystems is a plus.
* Strong product sense: can articulate problems clearly, write specs that start with "the why," and envision solutions at scale.
* Solid grasp of software development, integrations, and system design—able to go deep with engineering partners.
* Data\-driven, analytical, and a self\-starter who can take ownership from concept through completion.
* Exceptional communicator and influencer—comfortable navigating ambiguity and building alignment across all levels.

title: Digital Product Manager - Web Author
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
 **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
 As a web author, digital product, you will focus on providing content management system (CMS) authoring, design, and capabilities support for enterprise digital marketing projects across multiple business units. To be successful, you must have experience with CMS platforms, strong design skills, and the ability to manage digital content to support marketing initiatives. This is an individual contributor role. You will collaborate with other web authors, product managers, product owners, content developers and colleagues on cross\-functional teams.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Design Support: Collaborate with designers to produce and maintain web page designs that align with brand guidelines and marketing objectives. Ensure that web pages are visually appealing, user\-friendly and designed with a mobile\-first approach. Learn and support enterprise web standards, particularly user experience and accessibility
* CMS Authoring and Management: Create, edit, and manage website content using the company's CMS platform. This includes selecting and placing visual assets in alignment with brand standards, digital asset management (DAM) best practices and user guides. Notify teammates and manager of work progress and assist with troubleshooting
* Search Engine Optimization: collaborate with SEO colleagues to ensure all digital content is optimized for search engines (SEO) and adheres to best practices for web design and usability.
* Project Support: Assist in the execution of enterprise digital marketing projects, ensuring timely delivery and adherence to project requirements. Complete work related to daily ad\-hoc tasks and ongoing team projects, making sure all assignments are delivered on time
* Quality Assurance: Serve as quality assurance for final publishing. Conduct regular audits of website content to ensure accuracy, relevance, and compliance with company standards. Troubleshoot and resolve any content\-related issues on the website
* Content Strategy: Support the development and implementation of content strategies that enhance user engagement and drive conversions. Create and share documentation related to project work
* Collaboration and Communication: Work closely with product owners, development, marketing and other cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of content and design. Contribute to multiple projects across a range of business and web properties
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so


**Required Qualifications**
* 6\+ years of experience as an individual contributor in digital marketing, web content management or a related role and 3\+ years of experience with content management systems (Adobe Experience Manager preferred)
* Knowledge of web and mobile technologies and experience with digital marketing tools
* Solid understanding of web design principles, including user experience (UX) and user interface (UI) design with strong analytical and problem\-solving skills and the ability to create web pages with stakeholder requirements and within technical limitations
* Proven excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization
* Proven ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment and adapt quickly to changing priorities and business needs
* Proven to be organized, detail\-oriented and highly resourceful in your approach to work with the ability to work autonomously and manage time effectively
* Proven to be self\-motivated and ready to jump in when opportunities arise with the ability to quickly learn and use new concepts


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working in agile development environments and familiarity with agile methodologies such as scrum and kanban
* Experience working with complex design systems or design pattern libraries
* Some knowledge of coding languages, like HTML


*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
   

  

**Senior Product Manager, Loyalty**
**Team Description**
 The role sits within the Loyalty Product organization and is specifically focused on assurance products strategy for members across Hotels.com, Vrbo, and BEX. The broader loyalty team currently works across multiple areas including loyalty for other brands such as Expedia \& Vrbo, 3P partnerships, AI/ML\-driven personalization, promotions \& incentives etc.
   

  

 The team partners closely with brand GMs, marketing, engineering, design, finance, legal and other product stakeholders to improve the loyalty experience, drive clearer value for travelers, and increase outcomes such as active members, first transactions, repeat bookings, and direct return behavior for Expedia Group.

* Define the product vision and multi\-quarter roadmap for loyalty assurance products across brands.
* Set clear priorities across protection and flexibility offerings.
* Partner with InsurTech, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Finance, Legal, and Brand teams to drive discovery, delivery, and launch readiness.
* Define the member value proposition and eligibility model for assurance benefits within One Key.
* Use data, experimentation, and market insight to evaluate product fit and member impact.
* Drive the in\-product member experience for assurance products.
* Align stakeholders around strategy, priorities, tradeoffs, and investment decisions.
* Manage ambiguity, unblock dependencies, and keep multiple workstreams moving in a highly matrixed environment.
* Apply AI/ML and rule\-based contextualization and personalization to improve member relevance and business outcomes.

* A clear cross\-brand assurance strategy that connects loyalty benefits to repeat booking and member retention.
* A prioritized roadmap that balances member value, commercial outcomes, and delivery feasibility.
* Strong partnership with InsurTech that results in scalable, compliant, and brand\-appropriate launches.
* Measurable improvement in loyalty engagement, repeat purchase, and assurance adoption and usage.
* Clear alignment across business and technical stakeholders throughout discovery and delivery.

* An experienced product leader with a track record of owning complex, technical, cross\-functional products.
* Strong at product vision, roadmap definition, prioritization, and stakeholder alignment.
* Comfortable operating across brands, geographies, and business models.
* A clear communicator who can simplify sophisticated product and commercial concepts.
* Data\-driven, customer\-focused, and comfortable making decisions in ambiguity.
* Skilled at leading through influence and collaborating across functions without direct authority.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience leading complex product initiatives.
* Experience leading highly technical consumer or platform products in a matrixed organization.
* Proven track record of building and scaling products with multiple stakeholders and business constraints.
* Experience partnering with Engineering, Design, Analytics, and business stakeholders.
* Strong written, verbal, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a related field, or equivalent experience.

* Experience with travel, fintech, insurance, loyalty, or marketplace products.
* Experience working with partner\-led product models and regulated or quasi\-regulated offerings.

* Ability to connect customer needs to measurable commercial and member outcomes.

 Assurance products are becoming an important part of the loyalty value proposition and a key lever for making One Key more relevant across brands and traveler segments. This role will help shape how Expedia Group turns that opportunity into a durable, differentiated member benefit.

 Pluang is Indonesia’s leading multi\-asset investment platform, offering products such as US Stocks, Crypto, Indonesian Stocks, Mutual Funds, and Gold. Our mission is to make investing accessible, seamless, and secure—so more Indonesians can achieve financial independence. Backed by $110M\+ in funding from global investors like Accel and Openspace Ventures, we’re one of Indonesia’s fastest\-growing fintechs.
 
 Discover more about our vision here.
 




  





**Role Overview** 




 We are hiring a Senior Product Manager based in Gurgaon to join our Global Products team. You will own and drive product outcomes across global investing products (e.g. US Stocks, ETFs, Options, Leverage, Commodities, Forex and adjacent platform capabilities), translating strategy into shipped products with high quality and operational excellence.
 



 Given Pluang’s startup environment, scope can evolve over time. A meaningful part of this role will also involve helping build and launch Pluang Philippines (PH)—a highly exciting zero\-to\-one journey where you will launch the product by creating core platform flows (e.g., onboarding/KYC, wallet, top up/cash out, portfolio, and key trading/investing journeys) in a new market.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 




**1\. Own delivery and outcomes across Global Products (US Stocks \& Securities and beyond)** 



* Drive execution of roadmap items across US Stocks, Options, ETFs, Leverage and other products\- balancing customer value, risk, and operational constraints.
* Translate strategy into crisp PRDs, user stories, and release plans; ensure high\-quality delivery and clear success metrics.
* Own post\-launch iteration based on data, user feedback, and operational insights (not just shipping features).



**2\. Contribute to PH expansion (zero\-to\-one) through platform flows and market readiness** 



* Support building PH\-ready platform journeys including onboarding/KYC, wallet, top up/cash out, portfolio, and customer support readiness.
* Work with Strategy/Compliance/Partnerships to translate market requirements into a phased roadmap (MVP → iteration → scale).
* Ensure PH flows are measurable, reliable, and launch\-ready with strong operational and compliance alignment.



**3\. Build and scale core investing journeys with a high bar for trust and usability** 



* Improve key journeys such as discovery → onboarding → funding → trade execution → portfolio → reporting.
* Drive UX improvements informed by funnel analytics, user feedback, and market benchmarks to increase conversion and repeat investing behaviors.
* Ensure clarity and transparency in user\-facing experiences (pricing/fees, leverage risks, order status, trade confirmations).



**4\. Drive data\-informed optimization and experimentation** 



* Own instrumentation and metrics for your domains; partner with Data to ensure dashboards are trusted and actionable.
* Run structured experiments (A/B tests and iterative rollouts) to improve conversion funnels and product adoption.
* Diagnose performance issues and drop\-offs using cohort and funnel analysis; propose and execute solutions.



**5\. Lead cross\-functional coordination and operational excellence**

**Role : Product Manager II \| Nykaa Fashion**
**Location :** 
 Gurgaon \|
 **Experience :** 
 2 \- 4 years \|
 **Team :** 
 Product \- Nykaa Fashion
   

  

 Fashion meets Product. And we're looking for someone who gets both.
   

  

 Nykaa Fashion is building the next generation of fashion shopping experiences \- experiences that are more visual, inspiring, social and AI\-native.
   

  

 We're looking for a Product Manager II to work on some of our newest bets : ideas that may start with a customer insight, prototype or experiment and have the potential to become entirely new experiences for millions of shoppers.
   

  

 This isn't a role where you'll inherit a mature roadmap and optimize it by 2%.
   

  

 You'll find problems worth solving, build from zero, experiment quickly and scale what works.
   

  

 And there's one thing we care about beyond the usual PM toolkit : You should genuinely love fashion.
   

  

 You notice what people are wearing. You know when a trend is taking off. You have opinions on how people discover brands, put together looks and decide what to buy.
   

  

 You don't just work on fashion. You talk about it. You follow it. You wear it.
   

  

**What You'll Build**
 You'll work on 0 \- 1 bets for Nykaa Fashion across areas such as :
   

  

* New Discovery Experiences : Rethink how shoppers discover fashion beyond traditional homepages, PLPs and search \- from visual and inspiration\-led discovery to new content\-led shopping formats.
* AI x Fashion : Explore how Generative AI can change fashion shopping \- styling, personalization, conversational shopping, visual discovery and completely new interfaces.
* Content x Commerce : Build experiences where reels, creators, UGC, trends and editorial content become native parts of the shopping journey.


**What You'll Do**
* Build 0 \- 1 : Take ambiguous ideas from customer problems \- hypothesis \- prototype \- MVP \- experiment \- scale.
* Think customer\-first : Spend time understanding how people actually discover, evaluate and buy fashion \- not just what funnel dashboards tell us.
* Experiment aggressively : Run rapid experiments, learn what works and be equally comfortable scaling a winner or killing an idea.
* Use AI as a product primitive : Prototype with LLMs, multimodal models and emerging AI capabilities rather than treating AI as an add\-on.
* Own outcomes : Define clear customer and business metrics and take accountability for impact, not feature launches.
* Work deeply with Design \& Engineering : Build alongside designers and engineers from day one rather than throwing requirements over the fence.
* Stay culturally curious : Track fashion, creators, Gen Z behaviour, global commerce products and emerging consumer experiences \- and translate those signals into product ideas.


**Who We're Looking For**
 2 \- 4 years of Product Management experience, preferably in consumer internet or e\-commerce.
   

  

**You Will Probably Thrive Here If**
* You've shipped meaningful consumer products and can demonstrate measurable impact.
* You're comfortable operating with ambiguity and limited precedent.
* You have strong product intuition but are equally comfortable getting into data.
* You understand experimentation, funnels and consumer behaviour.
* You can work effectively with Design, Engineering, Analytics and Business teams.
* You're naturally curious about AI and how it changes consumer products.
* You move fast, prototype before over\-specifying, and learn from real users.
* Prior e\-commerce, discovery, personalization, content, social commerce or AI product experience is a strong plus.


 And the biggest plus? You are a fashion enthusiast. Not because your resume says Fashion / E\-commerce. Because you genuinely have a point of view on fashion. You follow brands, creators and trends. You understand why someone saves a look on Instagram, searches for it on Google, asks a friend about it and eventually buys something completely different.
   

  

 We want someone who can bring that instinct into the products they build.
   

  

**Why Nykaa Fashion? :**
 Because fashion e\-commerce still has a lot left to reinvent.
   

  

 Most shopping experiences today are built around catalogues, filters and funnels. The next generation will increasingly be built around inspiration, identity, creators, personalization and AI.
   

  

 At Nykaa Fashion, you'll get the scale of a major consumer platform with the opportunity to operate like a small 0 \- 1 product team. Millions of shoppers. Thousands of brands. And plenty of unsolved problems.
   

  

 Come build what fashion shopping looks like next!

Senior Associate – Brand \& Growth
 
**Herbaria – Modern Botanicals** 




**Location:** 
 Gurugram
 



**Experience:** 
 3–5 years
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Full\-time, on\-site
 



**Reporting to:** 
 Founders
   




 About Herbaria
 
 Herbaria – Modern Botanicals is a luxury, sustainable beauty brand creating colourful, fragrant and sensorial skincare rituals.
 



 We believe sustainability doesn't have to be boring. Herbaria brings together
 **botanicals, beauty, fragrance, design and conscious living** 
 to create products that are as beautiful to experience as they are considered for the planet.
 



 As we grow across
 **D2C, retail, hospitality, gifting and international markets** 
 , we're looking for someone who wants to grow with the brand and eventually take ownership of it.
   




 About the Role
 
 We are looking for a
 **Senior Associate – Brand \& Growth** 
 to work closely with the founders across the many facets of building Herbaria.
 



 This is a
 **high\-ownership, hands\-on role** 
 that sits at the intersection of
 **brand, marketing, growth and business development** 
 .
 



 You will help shape how Herbaria looks, sounds, communicates and grows — while also being comfortable stepping into a commercial conversation and helping bring business to the brand.
 



 This is not a role for someone who wants to work within a narrow job description.
 



 We're looking for someone who can
 **think strategically, execute independently, build relationships and get things moving.** 




 The long\-term opportunity is to grow into a
 **Brand Manager** 
 and progressively take greater ownership of Herbaria.
 


 What You Will Work On
 
  




 1\. Brand \& Brand Building
 * Help develop and execute Herbaria's brand strategy and calendar.
* Translate the founders' vision into consistent brand communication and experiences.
* Develop ideas for campaigns, launches, activations and brand initiatives.
* Maintain consistency across visual identity, tone of voice and consumer touchpoints.
* Stay closely connected to the beauty, wellness, fragrance, fashion and luxury landscape.
* Track competitors and emerging consumer trends.
* Bring fresh ideas that can make Herbaria more distinctive and desirable.



 You should have a strong instinct for
 **what feels right for the brand** 
 — not simply what is trending.
   




 2\. Marketing \& Campaigns
 * Plan and execute marketing campaigns across digital and offline channels.
* Work on new product launches, seasonal campaigns and gifting campaigns.
* Develop campaign briefs and coordinate with designers, photographers, creators and agencies.
* Work closely with the performance marketing team to align brand and growth objectives.
* Review campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve.
* Support the development of Herbaria's annual marketing calendar.



 You will be expected to take projects from
 **idea → brief → execution → review** 
 , rather than simply coordinate between teams.
   




 3\. Content, Social \& Creators
 * Help shape Herbaria's content strategy and calendar.
* Develop content ideas, concepts and creative briefs.
* Work closely with the creative team on social media and campaign content.
* Manage relationships with relevant creators and influencers.
* Identify opportunities for UGC, collaborations and brand storytelling.
* Ensure our content feels distinctive, elevated and unmistakably Herbaria.


 4\. Growth
 * Work with the founders and marketing team to identify opportunities for business growth.
* Track D2C, marketplace, retail and other channel performance.
* Understand key metrics such as revenue, AOV, conversion, repeat purchase and customer acquisition.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer acquisition and retention.
* Work with performance marketing and marketplace partners to support growth initiatives.
* Use data and customer insights to inform marketing and brand decisions.



 You
 **must be commercially curious and comfortable with numbers.**



 5\. Partnerships \& Business Development
 
 This role will also have a meaningful commercial component.
 



 When opportunities arise, you should be comfortable representing Herbaria and helping turn relationships into business.
 



 This may include:
 


* Hotels, resorts, spas and hospitality groups
* Premium retail and lifestyle stores
* Corporate and luxury gifting
* Cafés, restaurants and experiential spaces
* Brand collaborations
* Distribution and international opportunities



  





 You will be involved in:
 


* Identifying potential partners
* Reaching out and initiating conversations
* Presenting Herbaria and its products
* Preparing proposals and presentations
* Coordinating samples
* Following up with prospects
* Participating in commercial discussions
* Supporting negotiations and closing opportunities
* Maintaining relationships with existing and potential partners



  





**We expect you to be confident enough to sell an idea, sell a product and represent the brand in a room.** 



 What We're Looking ForExperience
 * 3–5 years of experience in brand management, marketing, growth, partnerships or a related role.
* Experience in
 **beauty, skincare, fashion, luxury, lifestyle, hospitality, FMCG or D2C** 
 is preferred.
* Experience working with a growing or entrepreneurial brand is a strong advantage.


 We Care More About Your Mindset Than Your Exact Job Title
 
 We're looking for someone who is:
 



**Brand\-sensitive** 




 You understand aesthetics, storytelling, positioning and why certain brands create desire.
 



**Commercially minded** 




 You understand that building a beautiful brand and building a successful business need to happen together.
 



**Proactive** 




 You don't wait for instructions for every next step. You see something that needs to be done and take it forward.
 



**Curious** 




 You want to understand the consumer, the category and the business — not just complete assigned tasks.
 



**Articulate** 




 You can communicate confidently with founders, clients, creators, agencies, retailers and hospitality partners.
 



**Organised** 




 You can manage multiple projects, stakeholders and deadlines without things falling through the cracks.
 



**Hands\-on** 




 You are comfortable doing the work yourself when required.
 



**Entrepreneurial** 




 You enjoy building in an environment where there isn't always a predefined playbook.
 



 Become a trusted owner of important parts of the business.
 



  




 The bigger opportunity
 
 The goal isn't simply to hire someone to execute tasks.
 



**We want to develop someone who can eventually manage and grow Herbaria as a brand.** 




 You will work closely with the founders and get exposure to the complete process of building a consumer brand — from
 **strategy and product launches to content, creators, retail, hospitality, gifting, partnerships and growth.** 




  




 Why Herbaria?
 
 At Herbaria, you'll be joining at a stage where there is still a lot to build.
 



 You won't be stepping into a large organisation with a fixed playbook and a narrow role.
 



 You'll have the opportunity to
 **shape the playbook with us.** 




 If you're ambitious, curious, commercially minded and excited by the idea of building a distinctive modern beauty brand, we'd love to hear from you.

description:
**Job Title: E\-Commerce \& Marketplace Growth Manager** 




  





 We are looking for a highly driven and commercially minded
 **E\-Commerce \& Marketplace Growth Manager** 
 to take ownership of our online sales channels and drive growth across marketplaces, our website, and other digital commerce platforms.
 



  





 This is not a purely operational role. We are looking for someone who can think like a business owner—someone who can identify opportunities, improve sales, optimise profitability, study competitors, develop new product ideas, and build new revenue channels.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will manage and grow our presence across platforms such as
 **Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, our own website, and other relevant marketplaces and aggregator portals** 
 .
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Marketplace Management \& Growth** 



* Manage and grow sales across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra and other relevant e\-commerce and aggregator platforms.
* Create, optimise and manage product listings, including titles, descriptions, keywords, images and product information.
* Monitor product performance and identify opportunities to improve sales and visibility.
* Plan and execute pricing, discounts, offers, bundles and promotional campaigns.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure inventory availability and minimise stock\-outs.
* Monitor product ratings, reviews, returns and customer feedback.
* Identify underperforming SKUs and develop strategies to improve or discontinue them.
* Identify high\-performing products and opportunities to scale them.



  





**2\. Website Sales \& Digital Commerce Growth** 



* Drive sales and growth through the company website.
* Identify opportunities to improve website conversion rates and customer experience.
* Create product bundles, combo offers, trial packs, family packs, premium packs and other initiatives to increase average order value.
* Develop cross\-selling and upselling opportunities across the product portfolio.
* Work with internal and external teams to improve product pages, offers and customer journeys.
* Develop strategies to increase repeat purchases and customer retention.



  





**3\. Customer Feedback, Testimonials \& Retention** 



* Develop and manage a structured process for collecting customer feedback.
* Conduct customer calls to understand product experience and satisfaction.
* Identify satisfied customers and collect written and video testimonials.
* Build a strong repository of customer reviews, testimonials and user\-generated content for use across digital platforms.
* Follow up with customers to encourage repeat purchases and referrals.
* Analyse customer complaints and feedback to identify opportunities for product and service improvement.



  





**4\. Competitor Research \& Pricing Strategy** 



* Continuously monitor competitors, their products, pricing, offers and promotions.
* Conduct regular market research to identify trending products and emerging opportunities.
* Identify products that competitors are selling successfully and evaluate whether they can be developed, manufactured or sourced in\-house.
* Work with internal teams to identify opportunities for competitive pricing while maintaining healthy margins.
* Prepare regular competitor and market intelligence reports for management.



  





**5\. New Product \& Revenue Opportunities** 



* Identify new product categories and opportunities that can generate additional revenue.
* Research products currently performing well in the market and assess their commercial potential.
* Identify opportunities to manufacture, source or develop products at competitive pricing.
* Work with internal teams to develop new SKUs, variants, sizes, bundles and product extensions.
* Explore high\-margin complementary products and add\-on opportunities.
* Present commercially viable new product and revenue ideas to management on a regular basis.



  





**6\. New Digital Sales Channels** 



* Identify and onboard relevant e\-commerce platforms, aggregator portals and other digital sales channels.
* Explore opportunities for affiliate marketing, referral programs and micro\-influencer partnerships.
* Develop strategies to increase direct\-to\-consumer sales and reduce dependency on any single marketplace.
* Identify potential opportunities in bulk orders, corporate sales, gifting and B2B partnerships where relevant.



  





**7\. Sales, Data \& Profitability** 



* Track daily, weekly and monthly sales performance across all channels.
* Monitor profitability at a product and channel level.
* Analyse the impact of discounts, commissions, returns and promotional campaigns on margins.
* Identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve profitability.
* Prepare regular MIS and growth reports for management.
* Take ownership of assigned revenue and growth targets.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* Proven experience in managing e\-commerce marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of online product listings, pricing, promotions and marketplace operations.
* Commercial mindset with the ability to identify new sales and revenue opportunities.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to understand product profitability, margins and pricing.
* Experience with website sales and D2C e\-commerce will be an advantage.
* Comfortable speaking with customers and conducting feedback or testimonial calls.
* Ability to conduct competitor and market research.
* Highly proactive, organised and result\-oriented.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of business outcomes.



  





**Preferred Profile** 




 We would prefer someone who:
 


* Has hands\-on experience managing multiple e\-commerce platforms.
* Understands both
 **sales growth and profitability** 
 .
* Can independently identify problems and propose solutions.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-paced and entrepreneurial environment.
* Has a strong interest in consumer products, digital commerce and new product development.
* Thinks beyond day\-to\-day operations and actively looks for new business opportunities.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Manifest Global
   

  

* Delhi, India


**What This Role Is**
 Right now, a counselor at a partner school in Manila is using Cialfo. A university admissions officer in Melbourne is using Explore to find the same student. A Kaaiser advisor in Delhi is talking that student's family through visa logistics for a course starting in six months. A BridgeU counselor at an international school in Nairobi is running the exact same workflow — on a different product, with a different roadmap, built by a different team that has never spoken to the other three.
   

  

 Four products. One flywheel. Right now, they don't know it.
   

  

 Manifest's own flywheel — more schools, more students, more data, better recommendations, higher conversion, more university revenue, better student experience, more schools — only compounds if the products feeding it are built as one system. Today they aren't. Each brand ships in isolation. Roadmaps are set brand by brand, not around where the ecosystem actually creates leverage. And Saige, the AI layer meant to sit across all of it, is live — but weekly active usage sits under 10%. That gap is not a marketing problem. It's a product problem.
   

  

 This role exists to close it. You will be the first person accountable for a single product roadmap across Cialfo, BridgeU, Kaaiser, and Explore — not four roadmaps politely coordinated, one roadmap built around where the ecosystem compounds. You will own where Saige goes next and why adoption is stuck below 10%. And you will build the data layer that lets a signal from a counselor in Manila actually inform a decision a product team makes for a student in Delhi.
   

  

 Nobody has built this yet at Manifest. That's the job.
   

  

**What Makes This Role Different**
 Most Senior PM roles mean owning a slice of one product's backlog inside one team's roadmap cadence. This one doesn't. You are being asked to define the roadmap logic across four products that, until now, have been built independently — and to make the case, product by product, for why a shared system beats four local optimizations.
   

  

 The Manifest ecosystem is the leverage here, and it's leverage no standalone competitor has. Cialfo's 2,000\+ partner schools generate counselor and student behavior no other platform sees. Explore's 1,000\+ university partners generate demand\-side signal on exactly which students convert and why. Kaaiser's on\-the\-ground placement expertise across India and Southeast Asia tells you where the real friction sits between interest and enrolment. BridgeU extends all of that into international schools globally. No other company in this market has all four data sources sitting inside one portfolio. Right now, that advantage is latent — sitting in four separate systems that don't talk to each other. You're the person who turns it into a live advantage.
   

  

 The broader overseas education market is contracting. Manifest is growing through exactly this kind of connective work — building the operating system underneath four brands rather than four separate products. This is the moment to be the one building it.
   

  

**What You Own**
**The cross\-brand product roadmap**
* Build and own a single prioritization framework across Cialfo, BridgeU, Kaaiser, and Explore — replacing four independently\-set roadmaps with one built around where the ecosystem compounds
* Make the call, product by product, on what gets built centrally versus what stays brand\-specific, and defend that call to each brand's leadership
* Run the quarterly roadmap review that connects product bets to flywheel outcomes — more schools, more students, more conversion — not just feature ship dates


**Saige AI product strategy**
* Own why weekly active usage on Saige sits under 10% today, and build the roadmap that changes that number
* Define what Saige needs to become to be genuinely useful inside a counselor's or advisor's daily workflow, not an add\-on feature nobody opens
* Set the measurement framework that tells the business, honestly, whether Saige is working — and keep the roadmap accountable to it


**The cross\-brand data layer**
* Architect the data infrastructure that lets a signal in one brand — a counselor's behavior on Cialfo, a university's admissions pattern on Explore — inform product decisions in another
* Define what "shared data" actually means in practice: what gets connected, what stays siloed for good reason, and what the first working version looks like
* Partner directly with engineering leadership across brands to get this built, not just specified


**Stakeholder alignment across four brand leadership teams**
* Build direct working relationships with product, engineering, and business leads at Cialfo, BridgeU, Kaaiser, and Explore
* Be the person each brand trusts to represent their reality accurately in the shared roadmap — not the person imposing a template from above


**What Success Looks Like**
 The markers below reflect where the product function is today. By the time you join, the business will have moved — new priorities surfaced, new constraints or opportunities in progress across the four brands. We will define the specifics together once you are in the seat. These are directional, not fixed. That said, the shape of success in this role is clear.
   

  

 You will start by building a complete picture: how each brand currently sets its roadmap, what data actually exists and where it's trapped, what Saige is being used for today versus what it was built to do, and where the real friction sits between the four teams that haven't had a reason to coordinate before now.
   

  

 From there, the first cross\-brand roadmap will be in motion — not a fully unified system on day one, but a working prioritization framework that at least two brands are operating from, and a first version of the shared data layer that proves the concept with a real signal flowing from one brand to another. Saige usage will have a clear diagnosis, a roadmap, and an early signal of movement.
   

  

 Over time, the product function at Manifest will look fundamentally different from how you found it: one roadmap logic instead of four, a data layer that's genuinely shared rather than four disconnected systems that happen to sit in the same company, and Saige usage that reflects a product people actually reach for. This will be a competitive advantage the business can point to, not an aspiration in a deck.
   

  

 The specifics will be calibrated once you are in the role. The direction will not change.
   

  

**What You Bring**
 You've built product inside a multi\-product or multi\-brand company before — not read about it, built it — and you know firsthand that the hard part is never the roadmap template. It's getting four teams who've never had to agree on anything to actually align around shared leverage, and doing it without becoming the person everyone resents for slowing them down.
   

  

 You think in systems and data, not features. When usage on something is stuck under 10%, your instinct isn't to add more onto the backlog — it's to find out exactly why, with data, before proposing what comes next. You're comfortable being the person who has to build credibility with four separate leadership teams before you can build anything else, and you know that credibility comes from getting the diagnosis right first.
   

  

 You operate well in ambiguity because you've had to define the system before anyone told you what the system should look like. Nobody at Manifest has done this job before you — there's no playbook to inherit, only a real, specific gap to close.
   

  

 Most importantly: you read the description of what Manifest is building — four products that should be one ecosystem, and currently aren't — and your first reaction wasn't "this is a good PM job." It was something closer to: someone has to actually connect these before the flywheel can work the way it's supposed to. That's the person this role is for.
   

  

**Why Manifest**
 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility — connecting students, schools, universities, and employers across 50\+ countries. Our portfolio spans Cialfo (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools), BridgeU (university guidance for international schools globally), Kaaiser (trusted study abroad counseling since 1997 across India and Southeast Asia), and Explore (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners). Together, we move talent across borders at scale. $700B flows annually in remittances from migrant workers. 85M workers will be missing from developed economies by 2030\. We're building the operating system that changes that. $91M raised. Still early.
   

  

 This role sits at the center of that operating system, not off to the side of it. The flywheel only compounds if the four products feeding it work as one — and right now, that work hasn't been done by anyone. You'd be the first. You'll have direct access to William, real ownership over a system spanning four brands, and equity participation at a stage where the product architecture you build in your first year will shape how Manifest operates for the next decade.

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
**About Atlys** 




 Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
 



 Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
 



 Atlys is changing that.
 



 We’re building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
 **1M\+ travellers across 127 countries** 
 . But we’re still early.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We’re looking for a
 **Technical Product Manager** 
 to drive the execution of complex technical initiatives across Engineering, Product, AI and Operations.
 



  





 You’ll bring structure to ambiguity, align cross\-functional teams and ensure critical programs are delivered with speed, quality and measurable business impact.
 



  





 This is a high\-ownership role for someone who thrives in fast\-moving environments, enjoys solving complex execution challenges and can build scalable systems that enable Atlys to ship faster and operate more efficiently.
 



  





**The Job** 



* Lead automation and platform initiatives that improve system reliability, operational efficiency and the scalability of Atlys' core infrastructure.
* Own end\-to\-end execution of technical product management by driving planning, prioritisation and delivery across Engineering, Product, AI and Operations.
* Translate complex technical and business requirements into structured execution plans, managing milestones, dependencies, risks and stakeholder communication.
* Build strong execution processes through program reviews, dashboards, metrics and operating cadences that improve visibility and delivery predictability.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment by proactively identifying blockers, making trade\-offs and ensuring teams execute efficiently while maintaining high quality.



  





**The Ideal Candidate** 




  





**You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You** 



* Have 3–6 years of experience as a Technical Product Manager, Engineering Product Manager or a similar execution\-focused role in a technology company.
* Have successfully led complex cross\-functional technical programs involving multiple engineering teams and stakeholders.
* Are highly structured, detail\-oriented and comfortable bringing clarity to ambiguous, fast\-moving environments.
* Are analytical and data\-driven, using metrics to prioritise work, measure outcomes and continuously improve execution.
* Communicate exceptionally well, influence without authority and enjoy working across technical and business teams to deliver ambitious outcomes.



  





*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.* 




  





**What You Can Expect** 




 Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
 



  





**Here’s What You Can Expect** 



* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning \& development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high\-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.



  





 Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
 



  





*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

 Identidad Tech · Remote (MENA/APAC) · Contract
 



  





 Do you know exactly which carrier to call when a route in the Gulf suddenly drops quality — and how to get it fixed before it costs a single dollar of margin?
 



 At Identidad Tech, we've spent over 25 years building telecom infrastructure for carriers and enterprises worldwide — Voice, SMS, Cloud Numbering, and Managed Services — from two hubs in Miami and Bogotá. We move billions of messages and minutes a year through markets most providers only reach through intermediaries, or don't reach at all. This isn't a support seat buried inside a big matrixed org: you'll own MENA and APAC's entire SMS/A2P vendor base directly, working shoulder\-to\-shoulder with our Commercial Director and Sales team.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Own and evolve the SMS/A2P product strategy and roadmap across MENA and APAC.
* Source, negotiate, and manage carrier relationships — pricing, capacity, and commercial terms that directly shape our routing.
* Chase down quality issues and cost inefficiencies across your vendor base before they become client\-facing problems.
* Scout and secure the network capacity needed to expand into new markets within the region.
* Feed market intelligence — regulatory shifts, operator changes, pricing moves — back to the rest of the business.
* Partner closely with Sales to match the right clients to the right regional opportunities.



  





**Requirements** 



* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in SMS/A2P procurement or carrier relations.
* Direct, provable experience managing carrier relationships in MENA and/or APAC — you know the vendors, the regulators, and the quirks by name.
* A real track record of finding and closing growth opportunities, not just maintaining what's already there.
* Strong negotiation and analytical skills — comfortable prioritizing across a large, varied vendor portfolio.
* Advanced English, spoken and written.
* Based in MENA or APAC preferred; open to candidates elsewhere with demonstrable regional experience.



  





**What we're looking for** 



* Someone who treats a routing or pricing problem like a puzzle to solve, not a ticket to close.
* A confident negotiator who's just as comfortable on a carrier call as reading a margin report.
* Someone who works independently and takes real ownership of a region without needing to be micromanaged.



  





**The profile that fits with us** 




 We're not looking for someone who manages a spreadsheet of vendors. We're looking for someone who actually knows these markets — who's negotiated with these carriers before, who understands why a route in one country behaves differently than the one next door, and who gets real satisfaction out of turning that knowledge into growth. If that's you, keep reading.
 



  





**What we offer** 




 🌍 Fully remote — work from where you know the market best.
 



 📈 Monthly fixed fee plus a performance\-based incentive tied to your results.
 



 🌴 15 days of annual leave \+ 5 personal days \+ 3 sick days.
 



 ✈️ Light travel — less than 20% of your time.
 



 🤝 Direct line to our Commercial Director and global Sales team — no bureaucracy between you and the decisions that matter.
 



 🚀 Real ownership of a region's entire carrier strategy from day one.
 



  





 Ready to own MENA and APAC's SMS growth story? Apply and tell us about a carrier negotiation you're proud of.
